comparison.position: 在固定环境的标准接口外组合初态重放、动作/转换/观察hook和串行任务，保留各基础环境的成功判据。
comparison.tradeoff: 它改环境而非模型外工具/记忆；可reset、可信verifier和新rollout验收是前提。本地只有CPU包装器，无EnvRigger、模型学习、真实bridge或安全sandbox。

analysis.title: 改Agent的执行层与改环境的练习层不能混为一个消融
analysis.body: Harness²在同模型同环境下比较工具、提示、记忆和脚本变更，再积累如何改进的证据；EnvHarness则让环境对特定弱点提供更好的练习，但保留基础目标判据。若两边同时改变，很难把能力收益归因到任一层。串行Chain的A∧B只是原判据组合，不证明任务语义兼容；Contract阻止捷径也不证明策略学到可迁移技能。完整EnvRigger要用freshrollout验收并回到未包装任务评测，本地未完成这条能力链。

question.question: 同时替换Agent harness和环境Contract，再见到成功率上涨，能归因到EnvHarness吗？
question.answer: 不能。需固定策略、任务划分和Agent执行层，再比较原环境与包装环境产生的训练/技能，并在未包装评测环境验收。固定toy包装器检查不覆盖学习与迁移，更不是两套系统已集成。
question.example: 教学例：同时增加测试工具并禁止直接提交，失败减少可能来自任一改动；没有分开对照就无法识别机制贡献。

update.summary: 补入EnvHarness环境侧可组合控制，区分Agent执行层和环境练习层；CPU三seed仅验Stage/Contract/serialChain合同，完整商业rollout和8H100训练不复现。

comparison.position: Compose reachable-state replay, action/transition/observation hooks and serial tasks outside a frozen environment's standard interface while preserving its original success verifiers.
comparison.tradeoff: This changes environments, not model-external tools/memory. Resettable tasks, trusted verifiers and fresh-rollout acceptance are prerequisites. Local CPU wrappers provide no EnvRigger, learning, real bridge or security sandbox.

analysis.title: Agent execution layers and environment practice layers need separate ablations
analysis.body: Harness² compares tools, prompts, memory and scripts under the same model/environment and accumulates evidence about improvement. EnvHarness changes practice conditions to expose particular weaknesses while retaining base goal verifiers. Changing both obscures attribution. A serial Chain's conjunction does not establish semantic compatibility; blocking shortcuts does not establish transferable learning. Full EnvRigger requires fresh-rollout acceptance and testing on untouched tasks, a capability chain absent from local wrappers.

question.question: If both an agent harness and an environment Contract change and success rises, may the gain be attributed to EnvHarness?
question.answer: No. Fix the policy, task splits and agent execution layer, compare learning/skills from original versus wrapped environments, then evaluate on untouched environments. Fixed toy wrapper tests cover neither learning nor transfer and do not integrate the two systems.
question.example: Teaching example: adding a test tool while blocking direct submission may reduce failures because of either change. Separate controls are needed for attribution.

english.update: Add EnvHarness's composable environment-side control, separating agent execution from practice conditions. Three CPU seeds test Stage/Contract/serial Chain contracts only; full commercial rollouts and eight-H100 training are not reproduced.
